name: Manuel
description: Manuel is a member of Argot Collective, an Ethereum Foundation spin-out working on compilers and developer tooling, where he builds source-code verification infrastructure for the Sourcify project. Most recently, his focus has been building an ERC-7730 decoding library for the Ethereum Foundation's Clear Signing Initiative, and researching the prototype behind this session. He has worked in the Ethereum ecosystem since 2018, on open-source projects such as Raiden Network and Beamer Bridge.
